description: Set or read the XML view and preferences: show the Structure pane, tagged frames, tag markers, text snippets, attributes, comments and processing instructions (View > Structure; Structure pane menu), small rows in the Tags panel, the Tagging Preset Options (default tags and colours for autotagging), and whether deleting content deletes its element. With no options, returns the current settings

deleteElementOnContentDeletion.description: Delete an element when its content (a frame or text) is deleted (XML preferences)

tagging.description: Tagging Preset Options: the tags autotagging applies, and their colours

cellTagColor.description: Colour of the default cell tag. Tag colour: a UI colour (BLACK, BLUE, BRICK_RED, BROWN, BURGUNDY, CHARCOAL, CUTE_TEAL, CYAN, DARK_BLUE, DARK_GREEN, FIESTA, GOLD, GRASS_GREEN, GRAY, GREEN, GRID_BLUE, GRID_GREEN, GRID_ORANGE, LAVENDER, LIGHT_BLUE, LIGHT_GRAY, LIGHT_OLIVE, LIPSTICK, MAGENTA, OCHRE, OLIVE_GREEN, ORANGE, PEACH, PINK, PURPLE, RED, SULPHUR, TAN, TEAL, VIOLET, WHITE, YELLOW) or "#RRGGBB"

showAttributes.description: Show attributes in the Structure pane (Show Attributes)

showComments.description: Show XML comments in the Structure pane (Show Comments)

showProcessingInstructions.description: Show processing instructions in the Structure pane (Show Processing Instructions)

showStructure.description: Show the Structure pane (View > Structure > Show Structure)

showTagMarkers.description: Show coloured brackets around tagged text (View > Structure > Show Tag Markers)

showTaggedFrames.description: Colour frames by their tag (View > Structure > Show Tagged Frames)

showTextSnippets.description: Show the start of each element's text in the Structure pane (Show Text Snippets)

smallTagsPanelRows.description: Compact rows in the Tags panel (Tags panel menu > Small Panel Rows)
